claim_text: Mitsui Fudosan and Mitsui Fudosan Commercial Management say a third party gained unauthorized access to the Mitsui Shopping Park app
summary: The two companies, which run the app, say a third party gained unauthorized access to it and that part of the Mitsui Shopping Park Point member data leaked as a result.
detail: The companies' notices of Nov 19 and Nov 26 both say so. NHK, ITmedia and Business+IT report the same.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 19 notice says: "第三者による不正アクセスが発生し、三井ショッピングパークポイント会員情報の一部が漏えいしたことを確認いたしました".

claim_text: The companies found the unauthorized access on Nov 18 and stopped the app the same day
summary: The companies say they confirmed the unauthorized access on Nov 18, stopped the app that day to keep the damage from spreading, and then found that some personal data had leaked before the stop.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 19 notice's timeline: "11月18日（水）：同アプリに対する不正アクセスを確認"; the same day the app was stopped and the leak confirmed.

claim_text: Data on about 3,119,000 Mitsui Shopping Park Point members leaked: member number, name, date of birth, address, email address, phone number and gender
summary: On Nov 26 the companies said data on about 3,119,000 point-card members leaked: member number, name, date of birth, address, email address, phone number and gender. Credit card details and passwords were not included.
detail: The Nov 19 notice listed five kinds of data and gave no count; phone number and gender were added on Nov 26.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 26 notice: "対象となるお客様の人数：約 311 万 9 千人", and lists the seven kinds of data, adding "クレジットカード情報やパスワードは含みません".

claim_text: The companies say they have found no misuse of app payments or points and no effect on connected systems so far
summary: The companies say they have found no unauthorized use of the app's payment feature or of points, no fraudulent orders and no effect on surrounding systems so far.
detail: The companies' own word; nobody outside them has checked it.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 26 notice says they confirmed "周辺システムへの影響ならびに現時点でのアプリ de 支払いおよびポイントの不正利用が無いこと".

claim_text: The companies say they have identified how the intruder got in, but have not said how
summary: On Nov 26 the companies said their investigation had identified the route and method of the unauthorized access. They have not said what it was or who was behind it.
detail: On Nov 19 they said the route and cause were still under investigation.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 26 notice: "不正アクセスの侵入経路と手段を特定し"; the Nov 19 notice said "具体的な侵入経路その他の原因については、現在調査中です".

claim_text: The Mitsui Shopping Park app has been suspended since Nov 18 and the companies have not said it is back
summary: The app has been out of service since Nov 18. On Nov 26 the companies said it will restart once its safety has been confirmed, and their notices list shows no restart notice yet.
detail: Shops, the online malls and the points scheme still work without the app, the companies say.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 26 notice: "今後、安全性を確認した上で、アプリサービスの再開を予定しております"; the notices list's newest item is that notice.

claim_text: The companies have made a preliminary report to Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission
summary: The companies say they have made a preliminary report to the Personal Information Protection Commission, Japan's data protection regulator.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 19 notice: "個人情報保護委員会には速報を実施しております".

claim_text: Members are being contacted one by one and warned about fake emails
summary: Mitsui Fudosan Commercial Management is contacting affected members by email and other means, and the companies warn members not to open links or attachments in suspicious emails that claim to come from the group.
detail: Members who cannot be reached individually are to treat the public notice as their notification.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 26 notice says affected members will be contacted "メール等にて順次個別に" and warns about "当社および当社グループ各社を装った不審なメール".

claim_text: Mitsui Fudosan Commercial Management, a Mitsui Fudosan company, runs 84 shopping facilities in Japan
summary: Mitsui Fudosan Commercial Management is owned by Mitsui Fudosan and runs and manages shopping facilities: 84 of them, counting its two online malls.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The company profile lists its shareholder as Mitsui Fudosan, its business as running and managing commercial facilities, and "84施設" under management.
